answer: I ran the 3-qubit GHZ circuit once on the real sirius QPU with 100 shots. The job ID is 01a15f4e-654c-7640-95b7-e1ae01ad955c and it completed. I did not submit any other jobs. The counts were 000: 52, 111: 34, 011: 4, 001: 3, 110: 3, 100: 2 and 101: 2. Bitstrings follow the IQM raw order, with qubit 0 on the left. 86 of 100 shots were 000 or 111, so the fraction is 0.86. The API does not report credits directly. It reported 1.0 billed second for this job. At the sirius rate of 0.3 credits per second, the job used about 0.3 credits. This credit figure is an estimate from the helper. The Resonance dashboard shows the exact cost. The transpiled circuit used 5 r gates, 4 move gates, 2 cz gates and 3 measurements. The circuit file is /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-325/ghz3.qasm.
